scripts.build: npm run sync:mobile-guide-flows && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:apk:lan: bash scripts/prepare-env.sh && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && echo "\nAPK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
scripts.build:ios:lan: bash scripts/prepare-env.sh && bash scripts/configure-ios-firebase.sh && npm run build && npx cap sync ios && xattr -cr ios && cd ios/App && pod install && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath /tmp/provider-app-ios build && echo "\nOpen: npm run cap:ios"
scripts.cap:build:ios: bash scripts/prepare-env.sh && bash scripts/configure-ios-firebase.sh && npm run build && npx cap sync ios && xattr -cr ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath /tmp/provider-app-ios build
scripts.test:provider-exp: npm run test:provider-exp-5.2 && npm run test:provider-exp-6.1 && npm run test:provider-exp-6.2 && npm run test:provider-exp-7.1 && npm run test:provider-exp-7.2 && npm run test:provider-exp-7.3 && npm run test:provider-exp-10.3 && npm run test:provider-exp-10.4
scripts.test:mobile-guide: vitest run src/lib/mobile-guide/mobile-guide.spec.ts src/lib/provider-guide.util.spec.ts src/lib/provider-guide-gating.spec.ts src/lib/provider-guide-assistant-seed.util.spec.ts src/lib/provider-guide-entry.spec.ts src/lib/provider-assistant-navigate.util.spec.ts src/pages/GuidePage.spec.ts src/pages/GuidePage.spec.tsx
